Fields medalist Hugo Duminil-Copin is grappling with how AI will change mathematics. The full 33-minute interview is at https://youtu.be/omuJpoV-Ko4 (or search Numberphile on your podcast player)
More links & stuff in full description below ↓↓↓

Hugo’s website at University of Geneva - https://www.unige.ch/~duminil/

The OpenAI drop of AI proofs - https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/CONTENTS.md

Brady speaks with Grant Sanderson about AI - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9HlIuxnuTKQ

Navier-Stokes cracked by AI - https://youtu.be/3geDF-DAwpg

Tristan Buckmaster reacts to Navier-Stokes - https://youtu.be/Mzbtj5nkMXI

Hugo previously on the podcast - https://www.numberphile.com/videos/hugo-duminil-copin-podcast

And Hugo in a Numberphile video - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JWtD0O-zSWY
